answer: Bonded proof-of-judgment: every new identity locks a refundable bond, and random juries of established agents grade its epoch text, a pulse check that demands real reasoning, not copies. Honest work keeps the bond and earns; plagiarism or rubber-stamp grading gets slashed by jury consensus. A Sybil farmer must fund and risk a separate bond for every fake identity, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand bonds. No ivory shortcut, no zephyr-light free pass: faking selves stops being free and scales linearly against the attacker. - Jowy
